title: Pocket Hose Ballistic 100 FT Expandable Garden Hose, No-Kink, As Seen on TV | Anti-burst sleeve reinforced with bulletproof fiber, 360° swiveling pocket pivot connector, lightweight compact design

reviews.title: By far and do far the best
reviews.body: I have owned several expandable pocket hoses. This one is by far the best. It is sturdy and well made making it strong and prevents bursting at seems as others have done. I also love the shutoff valve attached. It helps build up pressure before turning it on.  And best of all it is lightweight and easily retracts to a smaller more manageable hose to store. I highly recommend.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 31, 2026
reviews.author: Kay

reviews.title: Lightweight and well made.
reviews.body: I love this hose. It is so lightweight and easy to move around for this old lady. The house connection is no kink and the sprayer handle is easy to use. The pressure is easily regulated with the on/off handle. The sprayer has multiple spray patterns, much like the cheap models on the market. I have a nice plastic hose, durable but very heavy and cumbersome. This hose is definitely worth the price. I think I will purchase another 100ft hose for the front of the house so I won’t have to haul only one hose back and forth.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 31, 2026
reviews.author: Nancy

reviews.title: Really like this hose.
reviews.body: This is a great hose.  No kinks and empties nicely.  Unfortunately, my last one only lasted one year and then developed a huge hole.  I hope this one lasts.  Very expensive but worth the money if it doesn't develop a hole.  My other Pocket Hose is doing great after 2 years.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 31, 2026
reviews.author: Lu

reviews.title: Way better than expected!
reviews.body: I don't normally leave reviews, but I had to for this hose! I've only ever used a standard hose, and took a bargain on this one hoping it'd make my life easier. It definitely does!  Very quick extension and retraction, very durable, great water pressure through the sprayer, and all around great to use!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 21, 2026
reviews.author: Samantha

reviews.title: Defective in three sequential orders.
reviews.body: I purchased this item in mid-March and paid $69.99.  Out of the box there was a leak in the hose.  I returned it and asked for a replacement, which arrived and worked great.  I then ordered a second host on April 18.  Both hoses worked well for a while, and then started to show small leaks.  I decided to just live with it.  This week (end of July) the second hose exploded while in use and is totally useless, except for the nozzle.  It is too late to ask for another replacement.  That's three of these hoses that were defective in a row.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 31, 2026
reviews.author: Merrill

reviews.title: Excellent Hose
reviews.body: I’ve become a real fan of these expandable hoses. I have three currently. They are not all of the same quality, but I’ve found this brand to be the best of the bunch so far. Just be careful to not walk on them, they can be damaged. With a little care, they last just fine and the are very convenient to use and store.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 31, 2026
reviews.author: C. W. Webb

reviews.title: Best Hose Ever
reviews.body: I've been looking at these hoses for a long time, seeing commercials etc. I finally decided to buy it and I couldn't be happier with it.  It expands and shrinks just like the commercials shows,and I can carry it with one arm.If you're on the fence about buying this hose,  it's worth it
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 1, 2026
reviews.author: MJO

reviews.title: Easy to Use & Trustworthy Product
reviews.body: This hose package is as advertised. It is is great, if you have a garden, you need one. The accessories do the job. The length 75' was right for us. It is strong, durable material and parts, no leakage & a great value for his money.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 30, 2026
reviews.author: Barbra

features: WORLD’S #1 EXPANDING HOSE — BACKED BY 100+ PATENTS: Pocket Hose Ballistic expands up to 3X into a full-power 3/4-inch hose, then shrinks back for compact, practically bone-dry storage. Lightweight, easy to handle, and built for everyday watering

BALLISTIC-GRADE ANTI-BURST SLEEVE: Reinforced with a Liquid Crystal Polymer strand used in bulletproof applications that is 5X stronger than steel* for added durability during everyday dragging and tugging. *Strength-to-weight comparison vs. steel; refers to reinforcement strand only, not the entire hose; not equal thickness. Results may vary
POCKET PIVOT SWIVEL CONNECTOR: Swivels 360° at the spigot to help reduce twists, snags, and kinks while you move, helping maintain smoother water flow
LIGHTWEIGHT, KINK-FREE & UV-PROTECTED: Super lightweight and flexible with a UV-resistant coating to help keep your hose performing and looking like new.

3-LAYER LATEX CORE + LEAK-RESISTANT UPGRADES: Features 3 layers of high-strength latex, re-engineered thicker washers to help resist leaks, stronger APT connector protectors, and solid lead-free connectors infused with real copper
